backgrounds.name: Seen from the Earth: the space carried
backgrounds.description: The space round the Earth, as seen from the Earth, which moves up the page at 29.8 km/s. Carried: the space moves with the Earth, so from the Earth it falls straight in, as round an Earth at rest. A ball let go falls straight down.

layers.label: the flow of space, seen from the Earth

backgrounds.name: Seen from the Earth: the pattern taken along
backgrounds.description: The space round the Earth, as seen from the Earth, which moves up the page at 29.8 km/s. Taken along: the flow's pattern moves with the Earth but the space does not, so from the Earth the space streams past downwards at 29.8 km/s, bent in towards it. A ball let go beside the Earth is moving through that space at 29.8 km/s, and is thrown off its fall.

layers.label: the flow of space, seen from the Earth
